_doc: Live configuration for the MLB pitcher-vector and hitter inverse-vector layer. Atlas now uses vector projected xwOBA to adjust team run means before official moneyline selection.

run_translation.description: Projected lineup xwOBA delta versus the existing Atlas baseline is converted to a capped team run adjustment before tier, bullpen, park, win probability, and market filters.

active_gate.description: Official C8+ moneyline candidates must have both vector matchup delta and projected xwOBA edge on the selected side.
